rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: not_declared, succeeded, not_declared, succeeded, succeeded. Declared run-command probes: failed, succeeded, failed, succeeded, succeeded. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-001: run 1 launches a puzzle and a move changes its board and count. Run 5 receives New Puzzle but returns a page with no active session and zero total sessions. The recorded puzzle-launch outcomes differ. Reviewed coverage: 29/43 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 92/215 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Other launch paths and session configurations were not exercised. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: BR-009: after malformed save data, run 1 starts without an invalid-save notice; run 4 reports Could not read save file and displays a coherent grid. The required notification behavior differs. Reviewed coverage: 8/26 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 19/130 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: The recordings do not establish whether resets affect only damaged stats or progress. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
